source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_fans" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i fans (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the fan OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_fans SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve platform fan telemetry over SNMPv3 and verify every in-scope fan's physical identity, presence, operational state, tachometer speed and applicable control/redundancy semantics against the Project-approved cooling baseline in a declared system state.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP without defining fan objects, expected state or speed.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure SNMPv3, approve the chassis fan/zone/redundancy map and establish a safe ambient, power, load and fan-policy state. The agent can then perform bounded timestamped telemetry reads and comparison without controlling fans.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact fan inventory, tachometer, PWM and status OIDs
fan index-to-chassis slot/zone/redundancy-group map including intentionally absent positions
types, units, scale, state enums and presence semantics
ambient, host power/load, fan policy, stabilization window and expected RPM/PWM/state ranges
least-privilege SNMPv3 profile and manager ACL through protected secret injection
independent Redfish/IPMI/WebUI fan and thermal reference
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Keep the case read-only: never issue SNMP SET, fan override, PWM change, zone-policy change, fan stop/failure injection or power control.
Do not treat zero RPM as failure until presence, power state, redundancy policy and stopped-fan semantics are established, but stop immediately when the approved contract indicates lost cooling.
Do not use v2c, the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only/empty output as fan evidence.
Protect SNMPv3 secrets and bound reads to approved fan objects while preserving typed indexes, timestamps and errors.
Stop and escalate on fan loss, non-redundancy, thermal warning/critical state, implausible conversion or BMC instability; do not continue load or retry automatically.
Restore temporary SNMPv3 configuration and confirm fan policy, power state and cooling behavior are unchanged.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, resolve and query the exact vendor-MIB fan objects using bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK over the approved interval.
Correlate slot/zone/redundancy, presence, state, RPM/PWM and alarm values with the declared system state and independent thermal/fan telemetry.
Do not operate WebUI, alter cooling or power controls, induce failure, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the fan object/index/slot/zone/redundancy map, state semantics and operating-state ranges.
Establish and supervise a safe ambient/load/power/fan-policy state, configure and restore SNMPv3 and approve tool equivalence.
Own the immediate response to fan or thermal alarms and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The wrong security mode and unrelated demonstration OID cannot identify physical fans, zones or redundancy; grep discards typed RPM/PWM/state/index evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact approved vendor fan-table OIDs over SNMPv3, retain complete typed timestamped rows and compare them with the platform fan-zone and operating-state contract; keep all control objects out of scope.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT FAN TOPOLOGY AND COOLING CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each MIB index to physical fan slot, cooling zone and redundancy group, stabilize the approved ambient/load/policy state, collect presence/state/RPM/PWM samples, and correlate with independent BMC telemetry and thermal alarms without any control action.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified chassis, fan population, BMC firmware, cooling policy and matching vendor MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/fan population, BMC firmware, MIB, fan policy and client versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor cooling MIB, platform fan topology/control curve documentation and Project thermal limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical topology, zone/redundancy identity, operating state, quantitative ranges and a strict no-control boundary without replacing the original client checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Net-SNMP may prove the same protocol objects when approved but not IReasoning UI; fan presence, speed and redundancy are separate checkpoints and one cannot substitute for another.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fan objects/indexes/topology, states/units/ranges, policy/system state, reference and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Closed-loop fan speed varies with ambient, load, hysteresis and sensor updates; a single point or platform-independent RPM threshold can create a false failure.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define platform-specific fan zones, populations and state-dependent RPM/PWM ranges and may approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning, but must record original/actual tool, object-level equivalence, omitted fans/states and unverified GUI coverage.
expected_evidence: approved fan index-to-slot/zone/redundancy map with intentionally absent positions
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with exact OID/type/unit/scale/state/threshold mapping
ambient, power/load, fan-policy and stabilization context
complete timestamped typed presence/state/RPM/PWM/alarm samples correlated with independent telemetry
proof no cooling/power control changed, tool-equivalence statement, thermal logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` and fan acceptance are unresolved, and DeepSeek changes to v2c plus an unrelated generic subtree. The fan-monitoring purpose remains identifiable through platform inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fan topology, MIB objects, operating state and state-dependent limits are normal Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only cooling-telemetry purpose. Once supplied and manually configured, bounded sampling is automatable; permanent BLOCKED is not justified.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects the v2c/generic OID and adds exact physical fan identity, redundancy, state and no-control evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while preserving a hard execution gate until cooling inputs exist.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the classification while correcting its contradictory comparison wording and expanding closed-loop/state-dependent acceptance.

review_improvement: Separates physical presence, tachometer speed, control state, redundancy and thermal health, with state-aware acceptance and an explicit prohibition on fan-control substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fan RPM has no universal healthy value: it depends on fan identity, zone, policy, ambient, load and redundancy state. These facts cannot be guessed, but are supplyable platform inputs. Manual SNMPv3 and system-state setup followed by read-only automated sampling therefore fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, with immediate thermal escalation rather than automatic retry.
